---
description: Convert acceptance criteria and risks into mechanical pass/fail test oracles and evidence artifacts.
---

Read `AGENTS.md` and invoke `test-oracle-design`.

For each requirement/risk define setup, exact observation, pass/fail condition, command/tool, environment, tolerance/budget, and evidence artifact. Use API/SSE transcripts, state invariants, scanners, artifacts, and measurable latency/error budgets where appropriate.

Avoid subjective "looks good" criteria.
